title: Nectarous Malty American Chocolate Brownies
description: Halal-friendly, malty and gooey American brownies that showcase Oreo cream biscuits and tempered dark chocolate for a show‑off dessert experience.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C) and line an 8x8 inch pan with parchment paper.
Melt butter in a saucepan over low heat, then remove from flame.
In a heat‑proof bowl, combine chopped dark chocolate and melted butter, then stir until smooth.
Whisk in sugar, vanilla extract, and a pinch of sea salt until the mixture is silky.
Beat in eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition.
Sift in flour, malted milk powder, and crushed Oreo cream biscuits, folding until just combined.
Pour batter into prepared pan, smoothing the surface with a spatula.
Bake for 28 minutes, then let cool completely before cutting into 12 squares.
